LAREDO, Texas — Felipe Suarez was arrested just after midnight Friday, October 23, 2026, and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged state jail felony count of improper photography or invasive visual recording, according to Webb County booking records.

Suarez, 40, was arrested at 12:12 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department, according to the public jail record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. Bond was set at $15,000.

A state jail felony in Texas is punishable by 180 days to two years in a state jail facility and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Felipe Suarez is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

Webb Watch 956
